title: Woodcutter
description: A saw station that turns logs into stairs, slabs, doors, and more. No cheating on the material cost, just less clicking.
body:
Ever wish there was a stonecutter, but for wood? That's this. Drop a log in, pick what you want to make, and it spits it out. No jumping between the crafting table five times to get from log to stairs.

Here's the thing that actually matters: this isn't one of those woodcutter mods that gives you way more than you should get. Every recipe costs exactly what it would cost you to make by hand at a crafting table, just without the extra clicking and inventory shuffling. If a normal crafting table recipe would need 3 logs worth of planks to make 8 stairs, that's exactly what it costs here too. No free materials, ever.

Works with every wood type in the game, oak, spruce, all the nether woods, even bamboo, and every recipe adjusts automatically depending on what you put in. On top of the usual planks, stairs, slabs, doors, fences, and signs, it also makes chests, ladders, barrels, and crafting tables, so you don't need a separate trip for those either.

Requirements:

Fabric API
Install on client and server
